address: C. Colima 76, Roma Norte, Cuauhtémoc, 06700, Mexico
bio: This taqueria in Roma Norte specializes in northern-style tacos. The short list starts with their signature barbacoa de res which can be tucked into a corn or flour tortilla and is a juicy and flavorful morsel, particularly when done dorado-style, or shallow fried to produce a crisped tortilla. Any option is worthwhile, and the range includes a tempura-fried chile relleno or the machacado con huevo (shredded beef with scrambled eggs).The food is adeptly prepared in the small kitchen and guests grab a seat at the few tables or counter arrangement on the sidewalk....
